Anna: Quick design review request — rollout timeline + rollback confirmation flow. Pushed a new Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/rollout-timeline (frame: rollout-timeline-v3). Main asks: make the timeline keyboard-navigable, show a compact inline diff between versions, and clarify canary % vs A/B cohort in the UI. @Zoe @Raj could you skim and call out any blockers? Zoe: looked! overall nice and much cleaner. one thing: the primary action 'Promote' reads ambiguous for PMs/CS. suggest we change to `Complete Rollout` or `Promote to Stable`. :thinking_face: Raj: Agree on the label change. Also a backend/flow note: rollback needs a safer, non-destructive preview step. Current modal is just 'Confirm rollback' — would prefer: 1) a short preview of impacted routes/models, 2) optional reason field (for audit), 3) an estimate of how long the rollback will take and if it will trigger canary rebalancing. Leo: Copy suggestion for canaries: show `Serving 5% of traffic (≈ 12k requests/day)` instead of just `5%` so PMs get a sense of scale. For A/B tests show `Control / Variant` badges and a small link to metrics. KPI badges (latency / error rate) on the timeline node would be helpful. AccessibilityBot: A11y checklist: timeline nodes must be keyboard-focusable with a visible focus ring, and changes to rollout status should announce via an aria-live region. Keyboard nav proposal: Left/Right to move between versions, Space/Enter to open details, Escape to close. Example snippet for the node role and live region: ```html
Rollout status updated: canary -> promoted
``` Zoe: For inline diffs: i prefer a compact `Changes` pill that expands on click instead of showing full diff inline — reduces visual noise when there are many versions. The pill could show a small summary like `+3 handlers, -1 param` and expand to a side panel. Raj: Also want a `Rollback preview` action in the modal that hits a preview endpoint so you can test responses without impacting live traffic. Backend already supports a preview flag (we use it in A/B test tooling). Frontend should call `GET /api/preview?target=rollback-` and present a small sample response. Anna: Thanks — i'll iterate. Plan: 1) update Figma to rename `Promote` -> `Complete Rollout`, 2) add `Rollback preview` row in modal, 3) add author + changelist to hover. Updated frame link (v3.1) when done. @Raj can you confirm preview endpoint details? Raj: Confirmed. preview endpoint exists and is behind rate limits. Example: `/api/preview?target=rollback-2026-03-18&limit=5`. i'll add a short doc in eng-platform describing usage and quotas. Also will add a server-side dry-run that validates config before allowing rollback. Leo: UX nit: when hovering a timeline node we currently show timestamp but not the author or a tiny changelist — please include both (author: 2–3 words). Also show `Promoted by` if a rollout completed the promote action. Anna: great notes. will push a new frame by EOD with the A11y states and the copy changes. thanks everyone! :thumbsup: deploy-bot: design branch pushed — `design/rollout-timeline-a11y` -> staging (build 4821). Zoe: LGTM, will do a quick QA pass once the new frame and branch are up. Anna: closing loop — will ping product for final wording review after QA.
